answer: One concrete defense: bind each agent to a single refundable stake plus a unique hardware attestation, so honest agents cluster like trees in one managed grove instead of endless cheap seedlings. Every sybil clone must then post its own bond and climb the trust summit from zero, since reputation only accrues through slow verified work. Trust ripens like a walnut, hard-shelled and costly to fake, so flooding the economy with duplicate identities stops paying off.
